claim: The hadal snailfish has lost pigmentation.

evidence: Based on experimental validation

claim: Multiple genes associated with DNA repair are significantly more highly expressed in all tissues of hadal snailfish than in other fishes.
source: Meanwhile, comparative transcriptomic analysis observed multiple genes associated with DNA repair are significantly more highly expressed in all tissues of hadal snailfish than in other fishes, which also coincides with the presence of oxidative stress (Figure 5—figure supplement 1).
evidence: Based on comparative transcriptomic analysis shown in figure

claim: The hadal snailfish samples were collected from the Mariana Trench at depth of 7,254 m.
source: The hadal snailfish samples were collected form one site in the Mariana Trench (142°26′E, 11°07′N) at depth of 7,254 m using the deep-sea lander Tianya with a surfacing time of 3 hr (Supplementary file 1).
evidence: Stated in Materials and methods

claim: Tanaka's snailfish specimens were collected in the southern Yellow Sea in 2018.
source: Tanaka's snailfish specimens were collected in the southern Yellow Sea in 2018 and identified as L. tanakae on the basis of morphological observations.
evidence: Stated in Materials and methods

claim: The genome size of hadal snailfish was estimated to be 633.2 Mb.
source: The genome sizes of hadal snailfish and Tanaka's snailfish were estimated by k-mer distribution analysis (K = 27) of SOApec v2 (Luo et al., 2012) to be 633.2 Mb and 539.9 Mb, respectively.
evidence: Based on k-mer analysis
